# Version 3.119.3
> **Runtime reliability preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.3-preview.1.1)

> **Superseded by [3.119.4](3.119.4.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.119.4.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.3 previews runtime stability fixes, updated native dependencies, and hardened native packages. It addresses an AOT startup crash and Linux ARM64 runtime loading while refreshing the bundled rendering dependencies.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **AOT and Linux ARM64 startup fixes** — Fixes an AOT crash when reflection is disabled and includes fontconfig in the Linux ARM64 cross-compile sysroot. ([#3485](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3485), [#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates libpng, libwebp, Brotli, and related native dependency metadata. ([#3452](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3452), [#3463](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3463), [#3469](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3469), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478))

## Platform

- **Native packages gain additional mitigations** — Windows and Linux native libraries are built with the Spectre mitigation options. — ❤️ [@sshumakov](https://github.com/sshumakov) ([#3496](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3496), [#3502](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3502))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.4

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
